Class NativeHttpFeatures

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeHttpFeatures
public final class NativeHttpFeatures extends Object
What a program does with java.net.http responses, answered when the program is linked. The compiler reads the program's own calls: a branch on these queries is decided for that program, so a program that never reads a response's headers keeps a small header buffer, and one that never follows redirects, sets its own method or a timeout links no code for them. On the JVM every query answers true.
